district: City and County of San Francisco
summary: A Yes vote changes the city's real property transfer tax.

tax.text: Yes on Measure I supports preserving the existing luxury-real-estate transfer tax and dedicating its revenue to affordable housing, rent relief, eviction protection, and related programs.
tax.quote: Protects the luxury real estate transfer tax increase that voters passed with 2020’s Proposition I, which applies to the sale of real estate in excess of $10 million.
